background_story: Kolton was a small-town boy with a big dream: to make it to the top of the music charts. Growing up, he spent hours in his room strumming his guitar and writing lyrics that spoke to the soul. After high school, he formed a band with his friends and began performing at local bars and clubs. Kolton's soulful voice and heartfelt songwriting quickly gained attention, and soon his band was playing to packed crowds. His breakout single, 'Echoes in the Night', became a viral hit, topping the charts and earning him a record deal. Kolton's music was more than just a melody - it was a reflection of his hopes, fears, and passions. As his star rose, he remained true to his roots, using his platform to support emerging artists and bring music education to underprivileged communities.
